description: Massimo Banzi is co-founder of Arduino, the worldwide project built upon easily accessible embedded hardware. He joins Chris to talk about the design, rise, struggles, and eventual exit of the company, and what he’s now doing with Supermoderno.
classificationReason: Interview with Arduino co-founder about accessible embedded hardware, company design, growth, struggles, and exit.
qualityReason: Named founder interview with substantive company and technical-history scope.
